title: Inner Child Healing Workshop
location: Aarohana Yoga Studio, 135B, 2nd Floor, Jawaharlal Nehru Rd, BEML Layout, RR Nagar, Bengaluru
tagline: Heal the child within. Transform the life ahead.
description: A deeply transformative workshop designed to help you reconnect with your inner child — the part of you that holds unresolved emotions, old wounds, and forgotten joy. Through guided meditation, breathwork, and energy healing, this session creates a safe space to acknowledge, nurture, and heal those deeper layers of yourself.
